segments.title: Municipal Planning Commission Roles
description: MPC advises council on community planning and development.
Reports to City Council and standing policy committees.
Chair and Vice-Chair elected by commission members.
Members must attend meetings and review materials.

segments.title: Saskatoon Urban Land Development
description: Overview of Planning and Development department structure.
Official Community Plan guides city's long-term vision.
Development process includes sector and concept plans.
Applications involve internal review and public meetings.

segments.title: Secondary Suites in Semi-Detached Dwellings Presentation
description: Proposed amendments allow secondary suites in semi-detached dwellings.
Less onerous than building 4-unit dwellings.
Aligns with Housing Accelerator Fund goals.
Public feedback raised parking and congestion concerns.

chips.text: Public feedback raised concerns about parking and congestion
New policy allows secondary suites in semi-detached dwellings

segments.title: Repealing Direct Control District 2 Presentation
description: Proposed amendments to repeal Direct Control District 2 (DCD-2).
DCD-2 established in 1988 for specific area transition.
New land use designations proposed for corridor growth.
Existing one-unit dwellings may become non-conforming uses.

chips.text: Properties on either Wild Drive and cul-de-sacs affected by rezoning
New land use designations for corridor plan areas proposed

description: Commission will appoint its Chair and Vice-Chair for 2025.

chips.text: Approved

description: Rezones Idylwyld Drive, Stanley Place, Minto Place for higher density.
Allows multi-unit residential and mixed-use buildings.
Existing one-unit dwellings on Idylwyld Drive become non-conforming.

chips.text: Approved
Staff explained rezoning choice minimized non-conforming uses on narrow lots.
Residents on Minto, Aberdeen, Grey, Cannot cul-de-sacs own majority of properties.
Landowners expressed interest in development involving property consolidation.

description: Rezone 15 Eitherwild Drive sites to station mixed use.
Rezone 159 cul-de-sac sites to corridor residential.
Existing single-unit homes on Eitherwild Drive become non-conforming.

chips.text: Approved
Staff chose scenario two to minimize new non-conforming uses.
Residents on Minto, Aberdeen, Grey, and Knot own most properties.
Landowners expressed interest in development involving property consolidation.
Amendments remove local area plan's transition support for displaced residents.
Future zoning amendments could consider CM1 if sites are consolidated.

description: Updates city planning documents with new flood plain maps.
Removes a section on revoking development permits.
These changes are required for provincial bylaw approval.

chips.text: Approved
A councillor asked about development permits issued in error; staff confirmed it is rare.
Property owners in flood plains must consult the Water Security Agency for building elevation.
Section 4.3.6 was removed for consistency with the Planning and Development Act.
